resources.string: "This agreement covers your use of the Lyra Code Android app. The app works without a Lyra Code account. Third-party services are optional."
"Lyra Code stores app data locally by default and connects directly to the services used by each feature. It contains no advertising, behavioral analytics, or third-party crash-reporting SDK."
"“Required” refers to the feature in that row. You can skip optional features and continue using unrelated features."

"Lyra Code uses open-source libraries and third-party services. The table identifies which integrations receive information and when. Network recipients can see the connection IP address and request time."
"Permissions depend on the Android version and the feature. Android grants normal permissions automatically and asks you to approve runtime permissions and special access separately."
"2. What each feature processes and when"
"Swipe left or right to read all columns."

string-array.name: compliance_user_scope
string-array.item: "1. Scope and parties"

"This agreement is between you and the Lyra Code project maintainers (GitHub organization lyracode-app). It applies to the Android app and its local and network features. Each service you connect to has its own terms."

string-array.name: compliance_user_features
string-array.item: "2. Features"

"Lyra Code provides model chat, AI Agent tools and scheduled tasks, browser access to the phone, code editing, file management, previews, and local and WebDAV backup. It provides PRoot Linux, terminals, X11 graphical sessions, Termux integration and optional device interaction through Accessibility, Shizuku or Root. It also supports MCP, SSH, WebDAV, FTP/FTPS/SFTP, IMAP/SMTP, web search, local web serving, desktop pets and update checks. You choose your model and service settings."

string-array.name: compliance_user_rules
string-array.item: "3. Acceptable use"

"Use features only on files, devices, accounts and systems you have permission to access. Follow applicable law and the terms of connected services. Do not use the app to invade privacy, infringe intellectual property, send spam, distribute malware, access systems without authorization or disrupt services. Protect passwords and keys, and review Agent actions before granting approval or configuring unattended execution."

string-array.name: compliance_user_fees
string-array.item: "4. Fees"

"This distribution of Lyra Code is free and has no in-app purchases or paid unlocks. Model calls, ChatGPT subscriptions, New API sites, DeepSeek wallet top-ups, hosting, storage and connectivity may carry charges set and billed by their respective providers. You decide whether to use those services and bear the charges you incur. The sponsorship QR code in About can be used for a voluntary donation in WeChat. A donation does not purchase or unlock features."

string-array.name: compliance_user_intellectual_property
string-array.item: "5. Intellectual property"

"Lyra Code original source code is distributed under GNU AGPL v3. The Open Source Licenses page lists third-party components and their own terms. Brand names and trademarks belong to their respective owners. You retain the rights you hold in your input and files. Rights in model output depend on the applicable law, the provider terms and the content used to produce it."

string-array.name: compliance_user_responsibility
string-array.item: "6. Responsibilities and limitations"

"AI output can be inaccurate. Check code, commands and results before using them. To the extent permitted by law, you are responsible for losses caused by your unauthorized use, disclosure of your credentials, decisions based on unverified output, or execution of commands and changes you approve or schedule. PRoot shares the Android kernel and the app’s permissions. Third-party outages, fees and data handling are governed by the relevant service’s terms. This agreement preserves mandatory consumer rights and any liability the law does not allow us to limit."

string-array.name: compliance_user_disputes
string-array.item: "7. Dispute resolution"

"Contact the project maintainers first if you wish to resolve a dispute by discussion. If you cannot reach an agreement, either party may bring the dispute before a court with jurisdiction under applicable law. You may also use any consumer complaint or mediation channel available under applicable law."

string-array.name: compliance_user_changes
string-array.item: "8. Changes and effective date"

"The date shown at the top is the effective date of this revision. Revisions are published under Settings → About → Service Agreements. Material changes will be described in the app or release notes. If the law requires renewed consent, it must be obtained before applying the change to you. If you disagree with a revision, you can stop using the affected feature or uninstall the app."

string-array.name: compliance_privacy_contact
string-array.item: "1. Maintainers and contact"

"The Lyra Code project is maintained by the lyracode-app organization on GitHub. Open a GitHub issue to ask about this policy, report an issue, or request a way to exercise your data rights. GitHub Issues are public. Omit account credentials, personal documents and identifying details. Use GitHub Security for private vulnerability reports."

string-array.name: compliance_privacy_sensitive
string-array.item: "3. Sensitive information"

"Location coordinates and accuracy support the optional location tool. Screen text and screenshots are needed only for device interaction and visual recognition. They can reveal messages, financial information, account details and other private content displayed by another app. Camera images and attachments can contain faces, documents and location metadata. Account passwords, keys and tokens authenticate services. Disclosure can permit access, spending or changes on your behalf. Wallet balances are used for the optional balance display and alerts. Android verifies biometrics or device credentials when you enable full device access. Lyra Code receives the authentication result only. Skip these features, deny the corresponding permissions or use text and manual operation to avoid the associated processing. If you submit sensitive content to a model, a website, a remote endpoint or a browser client, that recipient can process the submitted content."

string-array.name: compliance_privacy_external
string-array.item: "4. Sharing, transfer, public disclosure and cross-border connections"

"The app sends model context and credentials to the selected model provider. Account requests go to OpenAI, DeepSeek or the New API site you entered. Search terms and webpage requests go to the chosen search engine or website. Mail goes to the configured mail server and the recipients you select. MCP calls, remote commands, uploaded files and WebDAV archives go to your configured servers. Active local servers send requested content to connected clients. Update, developer wall and download hosts receive requests for their public resources. The Third-Party Information Collection List identifies providers, fields and triggers.\n\nRecipients may process or store data in another country or region, depending on their infrastructure and your configuration. Lyra Code has no centralized cloud storage for local app data and does not route model and remote requests through a project-operated relay by default. If you enable a GitHub accelerator, that accelerator can receive the routed request. Check the provider’s policy for its locations and retention. The maintainers do not sell, routinely transfer or publicly disclose private app data. If law requires disclosure, the maintainers may provide the information they hold to the competent authority within the scope required by law. Your chosen sharing, publishing or backup destination can retain its own copy. Lyra Code displays its sponsorship QR code locally. If you scan it and pay in WeChat, WeChat Pay handles the payment. The app receives no payment result."

string-array.name: compliance_privacy_storage
string-array.item: "5. Storage locations, retention and deletion"

"App-managed records reside in Android app storage on your device. Workspaces and exported files reside in the locations you choose. Most local records remain until you delete them, clear app data or uninstall. Temporary storage and automatic cleanup are described in the processing table. Deletion removes the affected records or files from the app’s active storage. Files in shared storage, copies in other apps, browser downloads, WebDAV backups and data held by third parties are governed by their respective locations and require separate deletion.\n\nAndroid may back up or migrate eligible app data if you enable those system features. First-use consent, full device access authorization, New API session and remembered credentials, ChatGPT and DeepSeek Harness credentials, and PRoot environments are excluded from Android cloud backup and device transfer. App exports can include eligible settings and content, and can include keys when selected. WebDAV backups are stored at the server you configure. Android backup locations and expiry depend on the system backup provider and account."

string-array.name: compliance_privacy_security
string-array.item: "6. Security measures"

"Lyra Code uses Android’s application sandbox, local encryption for supported credential stores, system permission prompts and approval controls for selected tool actions. ChatGPT and DeepSeek Harness credential stores use Android Keystore. The app verifies bundled distribution downloads and checks update APK checksums when supplied. The web companion uses an access code for authenticated requests. HTTP or FTP connections can expose content and credentials on the network. Encryption depends on the protocol and endpoint you choose."

string-array.name: compliance_privacy_rights
string-array.item: "7. Your rights and controls"

"View conversations, profiles, files and service configurations in the app. Copy or share supported text and files, or export eligible records through Backup. Edit your profile, workspace files and service settings. Delete conversations, caches, files and configurations through their respective screens. To withdraw optional consent, stop the feature, sign out, disable scheduled tasks or revoke Android permissions and special access. Withdrawal stops future use through that authorization.\n\nTo remove app-private data including the initial consent record, use Android Settings → Apps → Lyra Code → Storage → Clear storage, or uninstall the app. Remove shared files, exported backups and remote copies at their destinations. Revoke provider tokens or ask the provider to delete its records or account. Contact the maintainers to request access, a copy, correction, deletion or an explanation of information they hold about you. Use the maintainer contact above for complaints. Provide only the information needed to identify the request."

string-array.name: compliance_privacy_children
string-array.item: "8. Children and teenagers"

"Lyra Code is a general-purpose development tool. If you are a minor, use it with your parent or guardian’s guidance. Children under 14 must obtain consent from a parent or other guardian before using features that process their personal information. The app has no age verification or dedicated child account. Guardians can manage Android permissions, stop connected services, delete local records and contact the maintainers to request deletion of a child’s data held by them. Do not submit children’s identity documents, contact details, school or location to models, websites or remote servers."

string-array.name: compliance_privacy_changes
string-array.item: "9. Policy changes"

"We publish revisions in the app and update the date at the top. If a change materially affects what is processed, why, how or who receives it, we will describe the change in the app or release notes and obtain renewed consent where required by law."

"Use Settings → App Permissions or Android Settings → Apps → Lyra Code → Permissions or Special app access. Accessibility, Shizuku, Root and Termux access are also controlled by the corresponding Android service or authorizing app."
